note: Sunday weekend run, 27 Sep 2026 07:02 SGT -- no new cash session has traded since Fri 25 Sep close (S&P +0.51% to 7,743.41, Nasdaq +0.48% to 27,068.72, Dow +0.93% to 51,828.62, VIX ~14.9, 10-year Treasury yield 5.18%, highest since 2008), so breadth/sentiment figures below are unchanged from Friday and re-verified rather than re-measured. What DID change over the weekend: Trump publicly rejected Iran's seven-day Hormuz roadmap on Sat 26 Sep, a planned Iran-Gulf-states meeting was postponed, and Iran's Araghchi said Sun 27 Sep that Tehran awaits a 'formal' US response without voiding the ~Mon-Tue 28-29 Sep deadline -- a harder line than Friday's truce-hope framing. Oil futures gapped higher into Sunday's Globex reopen (Brent ~$103, WTI ~$97) reversing Friday's pullback. CNN Fear & Greed was rechecked via mirror sites Sunday morning and remains flat at 37/Fear (no new reading, as expected with no new session). The BofA/EPFR Flow Show's regional/gold/money-market sub-split for the week ended 23 Sep was checked again and still has not been published -- the headline US/global equity-outflow reversal (-$21.1bn/-$10.2bn) stands as the freshest confirmed figure. The week ahead's key catalyst is the 2 Oct nonfarm payrolls report (consensus ~85k, down from August's 162k).
